abstract: RATIONALE AND OBJECTIVES: The authors describe the magnetic resonance (MR) imaging characteristics in patients with gestational trophoblastic disease (GTD) before and after therapy and to correlate these findings with human gonadotropin levels and the specific histology of GTD. METHODS: Thirteen women (mean age, 30.1 years) with elevated human chorionic gonadotropin (HCG) levels and histologically proven GTD underwent MR examinations of the pelvis. Magnetic resonance imaging was performed on a 1.5-tesla unit. Axial and sagittal proton density-weighted and T2-weighted and sagittal T1-weighted sequences were obtained. Four patients underwent follow-up studies after 4 and 8 weeks to monitor the response to therapy. Gestational trophoblastic disease was histologically proven with curettage in 11 patients and with hysterectomy in two cases. RESULTS: Nine patients had a diffusely enlarged uterus with pathologic signal intensities. In four patients, a focal tumor mass was observed. All patients showed loss of the zonal anatomy of the uterus in at least one local area. In 11 patients, no uterus zones could be identified throughout the entire uterus. Pathologic dilated tumor vessels were evident in all patients. In all four cases in which follow-up imaging studies were obtained, uterus size, signal intensities, identification of uterus zones, and uterus vessels returned to normal. CONCLUSION: Magnetic resonance imaging shows trophoblastic tumor infiltration as diffuse uterus enlargement, focal tumor masses, loss of zonal anatomy of the uterus, and pathologic uterine vasculature; this seems to be the most reliable MR imaging finding in patients with GTD. No correlation was found between MR imaging changes and HCG levels or specific histologic types of GTD.
abstract_ja:
目的と方法：妊娠性絨毛性疾患（GTD）患者の治療前後におけるMRI所見を記述し、これらの所見をヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)値およびGTDの組織型と関連づけることを目的とした。hCG値が上昇し、組織学的にGTDと証明された女性13名（平均年齢30.1歳）が骨盤のMR検査を受けた。1.5テスラ装置を用い、軸位・矢状位のプロトン密度強調像およびT2強調像、矢状位のT1強調像を撮像した。4例は治療反応をみるため4週後と8週後に追跡検査を受けた。GTDの組織診断は、11例では掻爬術、2例では子宮摘出術により得られた。
結果：9例で子宮がびまん性に腫大し、異常信号を示した。4例では限局性の腫瘤を認めた。全例で子宮の層構造が少なくとも一部で消失していた。11例では子宮全体にわたって層構造を同定できなかった。全例で病的に拡張した腫瘍血管を認めた。追跡画像を得た4例では、いずれも子宮の大きさ、信号強度、層構造、子宮血管が正常に戻った。
結論：MRIは絨毛性腫瘍の浸潤を、子宮のびまん性腫大、限局性腫瘤、子宮層構造の消失、病的な子宮血管として示す。これはGTD患者で最も信頼性の高いMRI所見と思われる。MRI所見とhCG値またはGTDの特定の組織型との間に相関は認めなかった。
